reviews.review_description:
ZG: Zombie Garden Defense is a brilliant evolution of the classic Plant vs. Zombies formula, reimagined for VR with fresh mechanics that elevate it far beyond a simple clone. Instead of just planting defenses, you can now shoot zombies directly with an arsenal of weapons, blending tower defense with first-person action in a way that feels both nostalgic and exhilaratingly new.
The gameplay is fluid, responsive, and endlessly satisfying—each level introduces fresh challenges that push your strategic and reflex-based skills to the limit. The progression system is deep and rewarding, letting you upgrade both your plants and weapons to tackle increasingly brutal waves of undead. Don’t be fooled by the cute aesthetic; this game demands your full attention, with difficulty spikes that will test even the most seasoned players.
A heartfelt thanks to the studio for bringing this hidden gem to the Meta Store—it’s a must-have for VR fans, strategy lovers, and anyone who misses the golden age of Plant vs. Zombies but craves something with more bite (literally). If you’re up for a challenge that’s as rewarding as it is relentless, ZG: Zombie Garden Defense delivers in spades. 🌿🧟‍♂️🔥

The default rotational pitch for guns on Quest 3 controllers is angled too far up relative to the hand model. Players have to aim their physical wrist down just to get the gun barrel level.  It becomes extremely uncomfortable very quickly.  Please add a Gun Pitch / Angle Offset slider or adjust the default grip vector for Quest 3 Touch Plus controllers.

I'm not a big fan of low-poly games, but when I got so lost in the gameplay that my headset battery died, it means graphics don't matter as much as I thought!

I found myself addicted to the gameplay on this one, with the typical tower defence strategy-style gameplay but now in VR and with a twist...you have a full body to run around, beat, smash and shoot the zombies with a variety of weapons from pistols, rifles, melee weapons and explosives... of course, the point of the game is to work with the plants, and that is the only way to win! 

You start with some basic plants, but as you progress, you unlock more along with more weapons you can purchase with the coins you earn from each level. Strategy and tactics are key, though, as without them you will fail. 

If you enjoy the addictive gameplay of Plants vs Zombies, then you are going to love playing Zombie Garden Defense with the full immersion of motion controls in VR!

reviews.review_title: Unique spin on tower defense. Nostalgic
reviews.review_description: i've had a lot of fun playing this game. it's a little early still, and there's some bugs they're working out, but i've probably put at least a dozen hours in so far. Planting and shooting is a fun game play loop. Highly recommend. devs have also been very responsive on discord.

If you've ever wondered what it would be like to combine plant defense with first-person VR action, ZG: Zombie Garden Defense delivers exactly that. Instead of just placing defenses and watching the action, you're right in the middle of the battle, planting powerful defenses while blasting waves of zombies yourself.

The gameplay is fast, satisfying, and surprisingly strategic. The mix of tower defense and FPS mechanics keeps every wave exciting.

What I liked:
🌱 Fun combination of strategy and action
🔫 Satisfying zombie shooting mechanics
🧟 Challenging waves that keep you engaged
🎮 Comfortable VR gameplay that's easy to jump into
🌻 Great replay value as you experiment with different plant combinations

If you're looking for something different from the typical zombie shooter, this is definitely worth checking out. Whether you're a fan of tower defense games or action-packed VR shooters, ZG: Zombie Garden Defense offers a fun blend of both that's easy to recommend.

This game has had me coming back evening after evening.

Simple concept that brings a bit of nostalgia back for me as well from the original Plants VS Zombies.
I love the simple but smooth graphics and gameplay. There are enough enemies to keep it interesting, enough plants that your attack and strategy can vary, and so much room for more development by the creators.
I give it a 4.9/5 because I just really hope that one day bring in a multiplayer option as I think it would really take things to the next level to play alongside a friend!

The game is amazing I really love the style and the mechanic￼s. The only thing that I would love to see a change is the graphics. I wish it was more cartoonish and more vibrant!

Overall the game has potential! ❤️🌻🧟
